Interlocked operational systems working in continuous synchronization.

Creation Phase

# About E-Cell RSCOE

The epicenter of innovation at JSPM's Rajarshi Shahu College of Engineering, built to turn campus thinkers into high-impact venture builders.

"Backed by an active community of 100+ student innovators and leaders, E-Cell RSCOE acts as the launchpad for scalable ventures—providing early mentorship, incubation access, and corporate connections to accelerate ideas into market realities."

## Strategic Blueprint

Our Core Trajectory & Purpose

Our VisionOur Mission

Long-Term Vision

### A Premier National Startup Cradle

To foster a community where innovative entrepreneurial ideas are nurtured and brought to life (implied from tagline "Ideas that matter").

National Recognition Founder Pipeline Sustainable Tech Innovations

## Ecosystem Architecture

Core Platform & Branch Tree

Our central nerve center coordinating support, infrastructure, and resources across all operational pillars.

Central Command Hub

E-Cell RSCOE Core Platform

Branch 01

### Startup Incubation & Acceleration

Mentorship pipelines, prototyping support, and direct pathways to incubators, angel networks, and seed funding.

Branch 02

### Hackathons & Innovation Challenges

High-energy national-level hackathons, ideathons, and venture pitch competitions designed to solve real-world problems.

Branch 03

### Investor & Industry Networking

Direct fireside sessions, masterclasses, and networking avenues with founders, CXOs, venture capitalists, and alumni entrepreneurs.

Branch 04

### Skill Development & Bootcamps

Workshops in product management, tech architecture, business model generation, and go-to-market strategies.

Branch 05

### Ecosystem Outreach & Community

Bridging inter-college entrepreneurship networks, government startup schemes, and fostering a builder culture.

### Ready to Turn Your Idea into a Venture?

Join the RSCOE builder community, find mentors, join incubators, and launch products that matter.

[Explore Our Initiatives](https://www.ecellrscoe.org/Events) [Contact E-Cell Team](https://www.ecellrscoe.org/contact)

# E-Summit '26

RSCOE's flagship entrepreneurship summit where ideas meet execution through talks, sessions, and startup showcases.

27 & 28 March 2026

RSCOE Auditorium

400+ attendees

[Registrations Closed](https://www.ecellrscoe.org/e-summit/register) [View Agenda](https://www.ecellrscoe.org/e-summit/agenda)

## What is E-Summit?

E-Summit is E-Cell RSCOE's three-day entrepreneurship experience that brings students, founders, and mentors together for meaningful learning and collaboration.

## Summit Highlights

### Keynote Talks

Insights from founders, operators, and industry leaders building impactful businesses.

### Startup Pitches

Student teams pitch their ideas and products in front of mentors and investors.

### Workshops

Practical sessions on product, growth, branding, and execution for early-stage teams.

![E-Summit Logo Mark](https://www.ecellrscoe.org/assets/just_logo-D52kd9gh.png)

## Thank You for Being Part of E-Summit 2026

We are grateful for the amazing participation and support from our community. Registrations are closed as the event has ended.
